name: tcp-half-close-fidelity
title: TCP half-close fidelity: deliver the upstream close and trailing data to a client that half-closes
description: A client that half-closes its connection (shutdown(SD_SEND)) must still receive the target's trailing frames and then the server close. The 2026-10-06 REL arm shows 545 of 601 half-closing attempts hanging to the 10 s client timeout (observed clean=56 vs expected 601) while the target ledger proves the FIN arrived and the trailers were sent.
creator: qmazon
